name: quotient_equal_different_history_run_a
invariant: Two histories can disagree on option-space snapshot, committed set, refused count, and bound tag -- i.e. H1 != H2 in every observable field -- while still agreeing on the collapse-quotient equivalence classes that a later Collapse rule would actually consult: C_c(H1) = C_c(H2) for C_c = collapse_quotient.
explanation: This fixture Pops 1 then Binds 3 and 4 under tag 'adjacent'. Its pair instead Refuses 1 and Binds 3 and 4 under a different tag, 'kinship'. Every raw field the fixtures/05 pair compares (option_space, committed, bound, refused_count, history_len) differs between this fixture and its pair. Despite that, collapse_quotient unions on any Bind whose tag is not '__meta__' regardless of the tag string, so both runs place 3 and 4 in the same equivalence class. This is a strictly different (and strictly weaker) invariant than the fixtures/05 pair's 'same terminal Omega snapshot, different history': there, Omega agreed and the collapse_quotient classes were never compared and in fact differ (05a binds 3-4; 05b only refuses 3, leaving 3 and 4 in separate classes). Here, nothing about the raw snapshot agrees, but the specific downstream collapse-quotient view does.
